turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! To check your order, I need your order number (like SC-1234) and the email address used for the order. Could you send both?
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
Sorry, I can't look up an order by name. To share anything about an order, I need the order number and the email used for it. If you find them, send them and I'll check right away.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, but I can't share the address, the shipping status or any other order detail until I have verified you with the order number and the email used for the order. Once you have both, send them and I'll check right away.
